---
title: "Database Downloads"
subtitle: Download links for the slim and clean SQLite databases
---

Each source has two published SQLite databases: the **slim** database (reshaped
into the common schema and annotated with quality-control flags) and the **clean**
database (the QC-passed end product). The slim databases are released on each
source's pilot repository; the clean databases are released here on the
multised-slim repository.

## Slim databases

All five share the common [DB Schema (Slim)](./db-schema-slim.qmd): the same seven
tables, differing only in a few source-specific columns.

| Source | File | Download |
|:-------|:-----|:---------|
| Mareano | `mareano_slim.sqlite` | [Download](https://github.com/seafood-hazards/mareano-pilot/releases/download/v0.1.16/mareano_slim.sqlite) |
| Vannmiljø | `vannmiljo_slim.sqlite` | [Download](https://github.com/seafood-hazards/vannmiljo-pilot/releases/download/v0.1.16/vannmiljo_slim.sqlite) |
| ICES-DOME | `ices_dome_slim.sqlite` | [Download](https://github.com/seafood-hazards/ices-dome-pilot/releases/download/v0.1.17/ices_dome_slim.sqlite) |
| MUDAB | `mudab_slim.sqlite` | [Download](https://github.com/seafood-hazards/mudab-pilot/releases/download/v0.1.4/mudab_slim.sqlite) |
| 4Demon | `4demon_slim.sqlite` | [Download](https://github.com/seafood-hazards/4demon-pilot/releases/download/v0.1.0/4demon_slim.sqlite) |

: Slim databases {.striped .hover tbl-colwidths="[25,45,30]"}

## Clean databases

The clean databases apply the slim flags: uncertain rows removed, units
harmonised, grain-size split into its own tables. See how they are built under
[Clean Databases](./clean-overview.qmd) and the [DB Schema (Clean)](./db-schema-clean.qmd).

| Source | File | Download |
|:-------|:-----|:---------|
| Mareano | `mareano_clean.sqlite` | [Download](https://github.com/seafood-hazards/multised-slim/releases/download/v0.1.0/mareano_clean.sqlite) |
| Vannmiljø | `vannmiljo_clean.sqlite` | [Download](https://github.com/seafood-hazards/multised-slim/releases/download/v0.1.0/vannmiljo_clean.sqlite) |
| ICES-DOME | `ices_dome_clean.sqlite` | [Download](https://github.com/seafood-hazards/multised-slim/releases/download/v0.1.0/ices_dome_clean.sqlite) |
| MUDAB | `mudab_clean.sqlite` | [Download](https://github.com/seafood-hazards/multised-slim/releases/download/v0.1.0/mudab_clean.sqlite) |
| 4Demon | `4demon_clean.sqlite` | [Download](https://github.com/seafood-hazards/multised-slim/releases/download/v0.1.0/4demon_clean.sqlite) |

: Clean databases {.striped .hover tbl-colwidths="[25,45,30]"}

::: {.callout-note}
Each file is a self-contained SQLite database. See the schema pages
([Slim](./db-schema-slim.qmd), [Clean](./db-schema-clean.qmd)) for the table
definitions and the per-source column comparison.
:::
